verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed Epic serves llms.txt on both www.unrealengine.com and dev.epicgames.com. However, the CDN intermittently returns HTTP 403 WAF challenges to curl, node, and python clients, so agents without a browser-grade client can't reach it reliably. Appending .md to doc URLs returns the HTML SPA shell rather than markdown, though some docs (Python scripting, Remote Control, UAT) are fetchable keylessly. Missing for 10: reliable non-browser access to llms.txt, markdown or agent-oriented doc variants, and first-party documentation of the llms.txt surface.
